categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance polyimide (PI) films. Its main product lines include thermal control PI films, electronic PI films, electrical PI films, aerospace PI films, and colorless PI (CPI) films for flexible displays. These products serve applications in flexible printed circuits, consumer electronics, high-speed rail transit, wind power, 5G communications, flexible displays, and aerospace industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company independently develops core technologies covering molecular structure design, PAA resin synthesis, precision film manufacturing processes including solution casting, biaxial stretching, imidization, and post-treatment. It also designs and integrates non-standard specialized production equipment and control systems. The firm has innovated environmentally friendly solvent systems and coating methods for thermoplastic PI films, enabling breakthroughs over foreign patent barriers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises such as Siemens, Bombardier, CRRC, Avery Dennison, tesa, and others. The end markets served are flexible printed circuit manufacturers, consumer electronics, high-speed rail, wind power generation, 5G communications, flexible display panels, aerospace, and new energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen and Jiaxing. It serves both domestic and international markets, though overseas sales constitute a smaller portion of revenue. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of high-performance PI films, supplying critical materials to downstream flexible circuit board producers and electronics manufacturers. It also invests in upstream specialty monomer development to secure raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in high-performance PI films targeting emerging applications such as 5G/6G high-frequency substrates, flexible electronics, semiconductor packaging, aerospace, and clean energy. The company emphasizes expanding production capacity, accelerating new product industrialization, and enhancing core technology independence. R&D focuses on low dielectric materials, high thermal conductivity films, flexible OLED substrates, and functional coatings for new energy vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance PI film products to downstream manufacturers and agents. The company follows a make-to-order and demand forecasting production model, with sales mainly via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global high-performance PI film market is dominated by a few foreign oligopolies such as DuPont (USA), Kureha (Japan), PI Advanced Materials (Korea), and Ube Industries (Japan). The company is the largest domestic manufacturer with the most diverse product portfolio, breaking foreign technology monopolies and achieving significant import substitution. It is positioned as a leading domestic innovator and competitor in the global market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 339 million, a 22.88% increase year-over-year, though it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 57.27 million due to increased costs and depreciation from new production capacity ramp-up. Total assets reached RMB 2.56 billion, with net assets of RMB 943 million. The company is in a growth phase, expanding production capacity and investing heavily in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a broad range of high-performance PI films with independently developed core technologies, enabling superior product quality, stable performance, and competitive pricing compared to imported products. Its products meet stringent international standards and certifications, with unique capabilities such as high thermal conductivity, excellent dimensional stability, and specialized aerospace-grade films. The firm emphasizes innovation, product diversity, and domestic supply security to support strategic emerging industries.
